summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj, a Finnish foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq Helsinki, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 30, 2026 board resolution establishing new share-based long-term incentive plans: the Performance Share Plan 2026-2032 and the Restricted Share Unit Pool 2026-2030. The PSP comprises three four-year performance periods beginning July 1, 2026; the first period uses absolute total shareholder return with a relative TSR modifier of plus or minus 20 percent. Maximum first-period rewards approximate 1,996,000 shares, with estimated aggregate gross value of roughly EUR 18.2 million based on the September 29, 2026 closing price of EUR 9.11. This is routine executive/employee compensation, not a special situation.
